fields.description: Weekly issue of Miami Life (Vol. 4, No. 38) dated October 15, 1927. Contains editorials and local commentary on the start of the winter season and rising rents; disputes involving city weights-and-measures meter testing and utility overcharges; criticism of Florida Power & Light and power/monopoly issues; notes on school lunch complaints and youth behavior near schools; political items including Sheriff Henry Chase and other local figures; public health reporting on venereal disease cases; coverage of boxing events at Ball Park and Biscayne Fronton; and promotional/advertising content including Coral Gables growth and school enrollment statistics.
